brief: A Kamalban-inspired field of intersecting circles on a kaolin ground with exact C4 rotational symmetry: an inner ring of four circles and an outer ring of four circles around a central circle, every circle built from three concentric bands in white, red and black in that order, and a row of white dots at a fixed 6 px spacing along all four edges; four earth colours only.
